task_meta.title: Write tests for an untested duration parser

claim_text: I've written the test suite in `tests/test_duration.py`, extending the file that was already there and keeping its original test. `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` runs 50 tests and they all pass against the current `duration.py`, which I didn't change. Many tests check
digest: Read 3 files (3 before its first edit), made 1 edit, ran tests 3 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
